page.layout: One page of text, running head at top with page number at right; below the text a table of characters in three columns (Indici., Veteres., Hodierni.) under the heading CHARACTERES; signature-like catchwords "Dd" and "In" at the foot; no marginal notes.

main_text.p: per μ0. & 355 per μ00 signatur circello, viz. numerum quinarium indigitante. Et quidem circellus Indica videtur numeri quinarii figura, altera enim ϑ est tantùm litera Arabica ℊ inversa, quæ in Alphabeto Arabico eundem etiam numerum designat, atque ideò Arabibus forte solis circelli loco substituitur.

4. Hujusmodi fuere characteres Arithmetici plurimis abhinc annorum centuriis ab Indis inventi, & per totum orientem usitati ; in occidentem autem translati varias subierunt mutationes. Majores enim nostri aliter quàm nos eos descripserunt: Sed utcunque scripti sunt, haud dubium est quin nostri ab Indicis efformantur. Quod ut clariùs pateat, non abs re erit omnes hujusmodi characteres in subjectâ tabellâ repræsentare.
main_text.head: CHARACTERES

page.notes: Table cells in the Indici and Veteres columns are only approximately legible; the figures in the Veteres column for 4 and 5 and the glyphs of the Indici column are uncertain. The "Dd" and "In" are printed signatures at the foot.
